Jean and Crystal Etienne have filed a $50 million lawsuit against Kimberly and Gianna Gotti, claiming they hurled racial slurs and physically attacked them at a high school basketball game in February 2024.

The lawsuit follows the dismissal of criminal charges against the Gotti women on a technicality.

The incident, which took place during an Oyster Bay vs. Locust Valley game, reportedly involved the Gottis calling the Etiennes’ son slurs like “f–king monkey” before a brawl broke out.

The Etiennes allege school officials failed to intervene and accuse Locust Valley High School of fostering a long history of racism.

The Gotti family denies all allegations, calling the lawsuit “frivolous.”

Source: NY Post

SPACECRAFT ZOMBIES: BACK FROM THE DEAD!

Turns out, space isn’t just for stars—it’s also full of undead satellites that refuse to die.

NASA’s CIRBE satellite went dark in 2024, only to randomly wake up months later like it hit the snooze button on its own demise. 

Meanwhile, IMAGE ghosted Earth for 13 years, rebooting itself over and over in a cosmic Groundhog Day before finally phoning home.

The culprit? 

Cosmic ray strikes, memory corruption, or just sheer stubbornness. 

Either way, these spacecraft are giving engineers existential crises and proving that sometimes, good design is better than luck.

Source: Space

Convicted ISIS terrorist Farishta Jami, 36, complained after police released a mugshot showing her uncovered face and hair. In response, West Midlands Police reissued the image, now showing her in a navy blue niqab with only her eyes visible.

Jami, a mother of 4, was found guilty of planning to join ISIS in Afghanistan and radicalizing others online. The court heard she saved £1,200 for flights and planned for her children to become martyrs.

Despite her distress over the photo, Jami attended her 3-week trial wearing a hijab that showed her face. The judge refused to mandate which image should be used, leaving it up to the press.

Jami will be sentenced at a later date.

Source: The Telegraph
